ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(detached house) District symbols as shown on Map No. 9-J

in the area bounded by:
A line 199 feet south of and parallel to West Roscoe Street; the public alley next east of
and parallel to North Hamlin Avenue; a line 224 feet south of and parallel with West

Roscoe Street.

To those of an RT-4 Residential Two Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 3339 N. Hamlin Avenue
